summary: Fresh import smoke+regression. Services healthy. GET /api/ returns {message:'VIBESMAI API'}. Public /submit flow (Playwright): form filled (full name, class XI 1, absen 42, YouTube link), POST /api/submissions → 200 with the exact bilingual success copy; background grader completed within ~20s (status=draft, ai_score=0 for Rick-Roll placeholder — not readable Indonesian rubric content, this is correct behaviour, no crash). /results shows the 'Halaman nilai belum dibuka' banner when results_public=false. /admin renders the Emergent Google login (button-google-login, link-login-home). Backend pytest regression (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL overridden to the preview URL since backend/.env does not expose it): 30/33 pass. 2 failures are expected (TestSeededAISamples needs 'Test YouTube'/'Test IG Privat' seeds from prior iterations — not present in fresh import). 1 failure (TestPublicResults::test_public_results_enabled_only_final_exposed) is a parallel-worker race on the shared `settings.results_public` doc; passes 2/2 with `-n 0`. No code-level bugs found.

minor.issue: BASE_URL falls back to the old 'vibesmai.preview.emergentagent.com' host because backend/.env has no REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Causes 100% test failures until REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is exported. Fix: either load frontend/.env in conftest or hard-code BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env.
Race against the global `settings.results_public` doc under pytest-xdist (-n 2). Add class-level isolation (e.g. serial marker, or scope settings per test class) or guard with retry.
Hard-depends on 'Test IG Privat' and 'Test YouTube' seed records that don't exist on a fresh import. Make this a fixture that seeds the records (or skip when missing).

action_items: Point /app/backend/tests/conftest.py at frontend/.env (or add REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to backend/.env) so pytest doesn't hit the old host.
Make TestPublicResults isolate the results_public flag (e.g. mark class as serial / lock the setting) to eliminate xdist race.
Rewrite TestSeededAISamples to seed its own IG-private/YouTube records instead of relying on pre-existing documents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 32 reads EMERGENT_LLM_KEY with os.environ[...] (hard fail on missing key) — good fast-fail.
server.py startup migrates legacy schema, re-queues interrupted grading + feedback jobs, and ensures ADMIN_EMAIL is seeded only if present — robust.
PriorityLock still correct (teacher PRIO=0 served ahead of background grading).
SubmissionIn still accepts legacy `video_url` alias — good backwards compatibility.
/api/submissions returns the exact bilingual success message the frontend expects — verified end-to-end.
Minor: @app.on_event is deprecated in FastAPI 0.109+; migrate to lifespan handlers when convenient (not blocking).
